The Archivist's name.summary: The records deputy answers to Shogo Kiriyama, 'The Archivist', the Intelligence captain: the unnamed suited face in the stills.
The Archivist's name.sources: voyage-memory data/arcs.json arc-4 hidden h-3a-captain (unlock 4-2) and villain_face/villain_sheet; arc-bible Act 2 Arc 4

steps.reveal: The records deputy answers to Shogo Kiriyama, 'The Archivist': power Still Frame (replays and walks through anything a lens recorded; sees through any camera he has touched; blind where there is no lens). Not a brawler; relies on guards and leverage.
steps.milestone_gate: Beat 4-2 Dead Zone played: the deputy or his phone gives the name

steps.reveal: He runs the Kurokawa eyes (bought CCTV, taxi drivers, bartenders and hostesses on retainer, blackmail files on officials) and is met in person at 4-3 on neutral ground, in a public place full of lenses; his pressure is footage of the PCs' own violence, not threats.

Replay's tape.summary: Daisuke Mogami, 'Replay', Kiriyama's bodyguard, has trained on the crew's fight footage and counters any move he has seen on film.

steps.reveal: Daisuke Mogami, 'Replay', Kiriyama's bodyguard: power Rerun (performs and counters any move he has watched on recorded footage; trained on the crew's fight footage). Calm, polite, bored; he mutters the source of each counter ('Tag Night, round two').
steps.milestone_gate: Beat 4-2 Dead Zone: he intercepts the crew

steps.reveal: His weakness: only what was filmed. A new move, an improvised combo, or a fighter he has no footage of (Mikoto) breaks his read; Dead Air does not touch him (memorized).
steps.milestone_gate: Beat 4-5 showcase fight: the crew cracks the rule

The Lumiere clip.summary: Kiriyama has watched Club Lumiere through a lens he once touched, Ayame's stream phone; the 4-3 twist plays the clip and changes the goal to 'go dark first'.
The Lumiere clip.sources: arc-4 hidden h-4-twist (unlock 4-3); twist; pc_tests; crew_subplot

steps.reveal: Kiriyama has watched Club Lumiere through Ayame's stream phone, a lens he touched at an earlier event; the twist at 4-3 plays a clip filmed inside Lumiere. The goal becomes: go dark first.
steps.milestone_gate: Beat 4-3 Neutral Ground: the clip is played

The dead-man upload.summary: The archive sits in a lens-free room inside a camera exchange; seizing Kiriyama without a key starts a dead-man upload of the crew's footage and the blackmail files.

steps.reveal: The archive is in a lens-free room inside a camera exchange; a dead-man upload sends the crew's own footage and the blackmail files to police and press if Kiriyama is seized without a key.
steps.milestone_gate: Beat 4-5 Lights Out: the crew reaches the exchange

The Kagero school's purpose.summary: Club Kagero's 'school' trained informants and honey traps to compromise officials, police and Ultra Force staff, then blackmail them.
The Kagero school's purpose.sources: arc-3a hidden h-3a-school (unlock 3a-5; the beat is past but the old repo still listed it as locked: kept hidden for parity)

steps.reveal: The 'school' trained informants and honey traps to compromise officials, police and Ultra Force staff, then blackmail them. Some were taken; some went willingly to clear debt; not every victim wants rescuing.

Okabe, the Teller.summary: The Finance captain was Setsuko Okabe, 'The Teller'; she survived Harumi Wharf. Her name stayed locked in the old repo.

steps.reveal: Setsuko Okabe, sixties, cardigan, reading glasses, runs the Finance office on Neon Lantern Street like a family bank and never raises her voice. The master ledger anchored every debt in Kobuncho; burning it voided every contract. Her power was never chosen (the old Promissory Mark was dropped).

The combat-data buyer.summary: The House circuit harvested combat data for an outside buyer interested in synthetic powers: an Act 3 door.
The combat-data buyer.sources: canon hidden_lore h-lore-house (unlock act3); arc-4 seeds (an invoice from Kiriyama to the buyer: mention once, never a hook)

steps.reveal: The House arc planned a rigged Saturday championship and a final liquidation at Harumi Wharf; the circuit harvested combat data for a buyer interested in synthetic powers.

World secrets (Act 3 doors).summary: Lore-level secrets of the Chikara Tokyo world, kept hidden until Act 3: Echo, Hush, Oblivion and Yuzuki's Stand.

steps.reveal: Ken Kuroda is the vigilante Echo; Seo-jun Kang is the serial killer Hush; Oblivion is Minato's biological mother. Yuzuki has a latent healing Stand she cannot see (older card; the user later confirmed she is FUSED with Verdant Sylph).
